metadata.description: Validate every vector file under test-vectors/ against the qauth-vectors/1-rc.0 format: required members, the schema id, no unknown members, unique case ids, throwaway-marked JWKs, and an id that matches the file's path. This directory holds no code, so the validator lives in libs/shared/test-vectors; its sources are inputs here because this project does not depend on that one (the dependency runs the other way, so a vector edit reaches every test that loads vectors).
Runs validate, so a local `nx affected -t test` checks the vectors. CI has no `test` leg; its `coverage` job runs test-vectors:validate itself.
